subject: gk
question: Appointment, posting and promotion of District Judge in a state are made by __________________.

options.text: Chief justice of the high court of the state in consultation with the governor
Governor in consultation with the High Court
President in consultation with the High Court
Chief Minister in consultation with Chief justice of High Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor in consultation with the High Court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The appointment, posting, and promotion of District Judges in a state are handled by the Governor of the state, in consultation with the High Court** under which the jurisdiction of that district comes.
 
• This is covered under **Article 233** of the Indian Constitution, which states, "Appointments of persons to be, and the posting and promotion of, district judges in any State shall be made by the Governor of the State in consultation with the High Court exercising jurisdiction about such State".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
